notes.title: BATTLE BRIEF: PATCH 05
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34486976/f547f3fce4e8a170630ff986223cafd616cbbdee.jpg

GENERAL CHANGES
* The Leaderboards have been reset
* 5 new custom skins have been unlocked for each faction
* Artillery now prioritizes Specialty Infantry over Basic Infantry
* Added the ability to extend the Path of a Unit that you are no longer pathing
* Slightly decreased the amount of damage the USA Artillery Barrage deals to Base Anti-Air
* Added short delay when pathing a unit before the unit starts to move, allowing for retargeting of units without moving them.
* Added ability to Toggle between Observer Mode & VR Mode in PC Builds via Desktop GUI. This is still in a "ALPHA" state and may still have issues we will be addressing. 
* Permanent Price Drop!
DIVISION CHANGES
* All Divisions:
 - USA Artillery Barrage and German V-2 Rocket abilities now cost $24
 - The range of Mobile Anti-Air Units has been slightly increased

UNIT CHANGES
* Beaumont:
  - Mortar Troops now take significantly more damage from Fighters and slightly more damage from Artillery
* Nickles:
  - The Priest has had its health significantly increased and its rate of fire moderately increased
  - The Priest now takes significantly more damage from Anti-Tank units
  - The Priest now costs $24
* Simmons
  - Heavy Bombers now take slightly more damage from Mobile Anti-Air Units and Fighters
* Von Ritter:
  - The Medium Fighter (Henschel) has had its damage slightly increased
  - The Medium Bombers now take slightly more damage from Mobile Anti-Air Units and Fighters
* Wulf:
  - Tiger Tanks now take significantly more damage from V-2 Rockets
  - The Walking Stuka (Artillery Truck) has had its damage increased moderately

BUG FIXES
* Removed REDStripe & BLUEStripe as options in the Customization Menu
* Fix for Unit Cap Warnings Labels not referencing correct Localization Key
* Fix for "Login Consecutive Days Achievements/Trophies" not properly tracking & firing
* Fixed "Waiting for Opponent" screen for custom matches saying "Unit Caps Off" when they are on
* Fixed "Player gets Stuck at PvP GUIs in Single Player Match if Opponent Declines Match"; this also fixes the same issue that occurs in the Tent
* Fixed an issue with the P-38 and ME-110 dealing extra damage; they have both had their damage output balanced to compensate for this
* Fix for P38 & ME110 Strafing shots dealing Damage to Air Units directly above the Point of Impact regardless of Distance from Impact
* Fixed Planes being pulled into a Dog Fight while they have a Direct Attack Target
* Observer Mode Fixes: Crash caused by Player 2 Looping Units Fixed, Both bases appearing Blue Fixed, Blue Team Units not Receiving Blue Stripe Skin Fixed, Observer not Receiving SFXs Fixed, & Observer not able to Exit Match after Completion Fixed

KNOWN ISSUES
* On Nickles first Story Campaign Mission, "Operation Iron Anvil" her Fighter Plane appears as an active unit that can be selected, when in reality it cannot be interacted with until the player collects their first War Chest

notes.title: BATTLE BRIEF: PATCH: 04
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34486976/e3b9f56f75423a095eae409c4cdffb3f05a0ab76.png
BATTLE PATCH 04
Big and best patch yet! Major updates to AI and balancing, along with bug fixing on many levels. We also have heard and answered your prayers by adding a "Remove Unit Caps" in custom games! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34486976/96924315ddbdc20c5d8bdf547a20a61df561b97e.gif
* Unit Caps can now be disabled in custom single player and multiplayer games. Unit Caps limit the total number of units a player can have at any one time. Turning off Unit Caps will allow a player to have as many units as they can afford.
 
GENERAL CHANGES
* Added leaderboard to the multiplayer menu.
* The Leaderboard standings have been reset.
* Fixed strafing bugs. Strafes can no longer include tight turns.
* AI improvements
 
UNIT CHANGES
* Beaumont's Flame Tank:
  - Takes moderately more damage from Artillery.
  - Deals moderately more damage to Towers.
 
* Beaumont's Mortar Troops:
  - Increased overal damage significantly.
  - Increased Health moderately.
  - They now take significantly less damage from Light Tanks and Fighter Planes.
 
* Nickles Commandos:
  - Takes slightly more damage from Towers and Artillery.
 
* Nickles Heavy Fighter (P-38):
  - Increased damage moderately.
 
* Simmons Heavy Bomber:
  - Now deals slightly less damage to HQ's and their Health has been slightly lowered.
 
DIVISION CHANGES
 
* All Divisions:
 - Tier 3 Anti-Air units now cost $15 for every Division.
 
* Beaumont:
  - The Artillery now costs $12
 
* Nickles:
  - The Infantry Troop Trucks now cost $7.
  - The M7-Priest has had its cost reduced to $20.
 
* Von Ritter:
  - The Infantry Troop Trucks now cost $7.
  - The Heavy Fighter (Henschel) is now on Tier 2 and costs $11; it's overall power level has been reduced.
  - The Halftrack MG is now on Tier 3 and costs $13; it's overall power level has been increased.
 
* Wulf:
  - The Artillery now costs $12
 
BUG FIXES
* Fixed stuttering plane movement in multiplayer.
* Fixed a bug in the matchmaking system that could cause players to not be able to find matches.
* Fixed map thumbnail images on new maps.
* Fixed some incorrect mission text.
* Fixed a bug causing some units not to run and gun when they should.
* Fixed bug causing units to sometimes spawn with less than full health.
* Fixed some matchmaking bugs resulting in connection lost errors.
* Fixed issues with various vehicle engine SFX audio not playing.
* Improved hand collision with buttons and sliders.KNOWN ISSUES
* On Nickles first Story Campaign Mission, "Operation Iron Anvil" her Fighter Plane appears as an active unit that can be selected, when in reality it cannot be interacted with until the player collects their first War Chest.

notes.title: PATCH: 03 VANGUARD DLC
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34486976/cb9279816a236722fd69d95354144e9e1a082fe3.png
Thank you everyone for your patience on getting some of these issues addressed as we launched our Vanguard DLC and PSVR port. We have identified and fixed some of the core issues that players have been finding including the AUDIO ISSUE with the Oculus. Thank you again for all the support and attention to the DLC and helping us fix any and all issues we can in a timely manor. Any issues that do come up, please report them here or on our discord and we will address them asap!
We are also reviewing all input and suggestions on balancing across the board and hope to narrow down priorities and get them into the next patch. Again, hit up our Discord for input and feedback as well.
Thank you for all your support!
Bug fixes and performance improvements.

 Fixed a bug causing audio not to play through Oculus HMDs.
 Fixed a bug causing audio not to play when the game is not in focus.
 Fixed stuttering plane movement in multiplayer.
 Fixed a bug in the matchmaking system that could cause players to not be able to find matches.
 Fixed map thumbnail images on new maps.
 Fixed some incorrect mission text.
 Fixed a bug causing some units not to run and gun when they should.
 Improved hand collision with buttons and sliders.

notes.title: FINAL ASSAULT: PATCH 02
notes.notes:
ATTENTION SOLDIERS
New updates coming your way with full military support! 
CHANGES

 (Map) Chateau Tod line of sight issues addressed: long range sniper vehicles can no longer shoot through the rocks on the map edges.
 German Hetzer Tank Destroyers and American Anti-Tank Guns now deal less damage to Towers.
 American Mortar Infantry have more health and fire slightly faster.
 Towers take significantly more damage from the U.S. Artillery Barrage.


BUG FIXES

 Fixed  issue where if the Final Assault game window became out of focus players could  experience performance degrade.
 Improvements to Strafing/Bombing.
 Wulf Mission 04 is now winnable on Veteran Difficulty.
 The Tiger Tank in Nickles Mission 02 now paths around the map reliably.
 German Artillery now takes correct damage from anti-armor units.
 AI Improvements to Nickles and Von Ritter.
 Achievement synchronization fixes


KNOWN ISSUES
When spawning new units, a unit will occasionally teleport to the spawn location instead of pathing from the HQ to the spawn point. We are working on a fix.

notes.title: Update: Patch 0.9.5
notes.notes:
NEW BUILD PATCH NOTES 

* Galland’s Story Campaign is now available.
* Steam & Oculus Achievements have been activated.

CHANGES
* The U.S. Anti-Tank Gun is now a (very slow) mobile unit.
* Unit health bars now display as BLUE for your team and RED for the enemy.
* We have expanded the tutorial and now explain more game features.
* The Unit Info Pull Out tab on the clipboard has been updated.
* AI changed how it decides what to spawn next.
* Voice over dialogue updated for Simmons, Nickels, Wulf, Von Ritter and Galland.
* Units put into a loop have a more visible effect.
* Health bars over bases auto-hide when you are near them so they won’t block your view of the game.

BUG FIXES
* War Chests now drop correctly.
* Unit pathing improvements on Stronghold. Units no longer attempt to path through the ponds to get to the War Chest drop locations.
* Campaign Victory/Defeat Conditions Fixed.
* The AI will no longer spawn large amounts of planes and keep them over its base.
* The Artillery will now prioritize Infantry units over Towers.
* Fixed a bug with the AI that prevented it from seeing War Chests that were sitting next to one of its units.
* Fixed issue with multiplayer reconnect code not firing when player loses connection to Platform Services (Steam/Oculus/Viveport) or Phaser Lock Matchmaking Servers.

KNOWN ISSUES:
* Artillery/Bazooka Troops/Probably other Units will sometimes fire across the entire map.
* Tutorial VO is temp and will be updated 
* When spawning new units, a unit will occasionally teleport to the spawn location instead of pathing to it from your HQ.
* Some temporary VO is still in the game.
* German Fighter plane missing team colors on clipboard.

For comments, suggestions or bug reports please visit our forums at www.phaserlock.com/forum/
Join our Discord community by visiting www.finalassaultvr.com and clicking the Discord button!
